title: OwnMesh device workspace registry snapshot
description: Full device-local workspace registry snapshot as advertised in ready.workspace_registry and in incremental workspace.registry refreshes (ADR 0014). Identifiers and generations follow the domain shapes; the Control Plane additionally requires ws_default, sorted unique ids, and at most 64 entries.

enforce_workspace.description: Device policy: restricted modes pin exec cwd to a registered workspace root.

generation.description: Opaque generation that changes whenever the workspace root changes; the only mapping fact sent off-device.
